comment: Three parameters, Panel Hue, Panel Saturation and Panel Lightness, have no widget on the panel and are reached only through the menu sliders, so they get no line of their own beyond the menu. The whole process block is skipped unless the Out jack is connected, OFS.cpp:46. With In empty the Trg jack is never written. The quantizer keeps the channels of Qnt that lie within one volt of the lowest and splits the octave equally between them, OFS.cpp:78-95, so the tuning of those pitches sets the steps but not their spacing.
